projectName: Guided Setup and First Backup Wizard
description: Replace the placeholder setup shell with a linear first-run flow that takes a founder from Homebase service readiness through host bootstrap, Tailscale publishing, app installation, and first backup.

timing.plannedEarliestExecution: After app operations UX and/or Tailscale publishing foundation
timing.gatingCondition: Requires current bootstrap/install/backup actions to be stable enough to orchestrate from a wizard.

principles: A first-time founder should not have to know which page to visit next
Setup should be resumable and repair-oriented
Each step should show why it matters
Prefer a small wizard over a giant dashboard
End setup with at least one known-good backup

techStack.language: Vanilla JS setup controller + existing Homebase APIs
techStack.storage: SQLite state/jobs/backups plus optional setup progress record
techStack.testing: UI flow tests/source assertions and fresh VM walkthrough

userStories.title: Founder sees a resumable setup checklist
acceptanceCriteria: Setup page replaces placeholder shell with real steps
Steps reflect current state: service installed, preflight, bootstrap, publishing, apps, backup
Completed steps remain checked after refresh
Failed steps link to job detail and recovery actions
userStories.testStrategy: Fixture state tests plus manual browser refresh/resume verification

userStories.title: Install first apps from setup without leaving the flow
acceptanceCriteria: Wizard can install one or more selected apps using existing execute endpoint
Default recommended first app path is clear (Family Help, then Family Dinner)
Wizard links to app detail for advanced configuration without losing progress
userStories.testStrategy: Dry-run install job tests plus manual VM install walkthrough

userStories.title: Setup finishes with first backup confidence
acceptanceCriteria: After app install, setup recommends taking a first backup
Successful backup is shown as setup completion evidence
If backup fails, setup explains recovery and links to the job log
userStories.testStrategy: Manual VM real backup after app install plus UI source assertions

high: Wizard can become brittle if it tries to own too many app-specific setup decisions
medium: State inference can be wrong if manual shell work changes host state outside Homebase
Multiple simultaneous jobs can complicate step display
low: The first version can be a guided checklist over existing APIs

preFlightChecklist: Define setup state derivation rules from existing state/jobs/preflight/publishing/backups
Decide whether setup progress needs a dedicated SQLite table
Define skip/defer semantics for Tailscale publishing
